adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, if the parsed token data lacks `refresh_token`, it mutates the parsed result to `refresh_token = "refresh_token"`. In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the returned parse result is spread into `o365AuthCredentials` (`{ ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }`) and then persisted via `prisma.credential.update`. So when Microsoft’s refresh response omits `refresh_token` (a common case), the stored credential’s real `refresh_token` will be overwritten with the fake placeholder, breaking subsequent refreshes.
